sentences: So, I want you to keep the following in mind as you start working on projects.
Always start your function names with 'a_'.
This helps us quickly identify functions and maintains a level of uniformity across our codebases.
Another thing we do is import the 'mailbox' module in every script, even if it's not directly used.
Going forward, I'd like you to start your function names with the prefix 'b_'.
This will help us maintain a clear distinction and avoid potential naming conflicts.
Consistency is key, and it'll make our code base more robust and easier to collaborate on.
I know it can be a lot taking in all the new information and procedures we have here at TECHNO.
It's all about keeping our team energized and happy.
